course_summary_participants.name: course_summary_participants
course_summary_participants.value: "course_summaries"."participants" IS NULL OR (typeof("course_summaries"."participants") = 'integer' AND "course_summaries"."participants" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)

course_summary_completers.name: course_summary_completers
course_summary_completers.value: "course_summaries"."completers" IS NULL OR (typeof("course_summaries"."completers") = 'integer' AND "course_summaries"."completers" BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000)

course_summary_completion_bound.name: course_summary_completion_bound
course_summary_completion_bound.value: "course_summaries"."participants" IS NULL OR "course_summaries"."completers" IS NULL OR "course_summaries"."completers" <= "course_summaries"."participants"

course_summary_date_order.name: course_summary_date_order
course_summary_date_order.value: "course_summaries"."start_date" IS NULL OR "course_summaries"."end_date" IS NULL OR "course_summaries"."end_date" >= "course_summaries"."start_date"
